## Methods

::: {.workflow-tables}
### Lotus screened Slater exchange, 6-31G, fixed geometry

The Lotus code iterates the density, screened Slater exchange and electronic response together at a fixed geometry in the 6-31G basis until the screening $\varepsilon_s$ converges.
